name: HoloMoves: Package Panic
summary:
PackagePanic is a mixed-reality exergame designed to playfully support shoulder rehabilitation by improving shoulder mobility and strength endurance in a playful and motivating environment. In a visual sorting center, players are invited to pick up and sort packages with symbols, providing a wide variety of therapeutically relevant movements.
The game features two distinct levels tailored to different rehabilitation stages:
